_README: Visual + voice system. The renderer reads colors/type from active_palette; the copy engine reads voice and banned_words. Nothing in the pipeline hardcodes a hex value.
_palette_note: The brief's muted natural palette, with deep charcoal used as a real surface rather than only as type colour. 'natural' is a two-surface system: charcoal ground for Answer and Offer, warm ivory for Ritual. That gives the grid a 2:1 dark-to-light rhythm — close to the existing feed's weight, but in the brief's palette instead of gold. Set active_palette to 'daylight' for all-ivory, or 'obsidian' for the original black-and-gold.

daylight._note: Token names are inherited from the original build and now read inverted: 'ink' is the ground (warm ivory), 'ivory' is the type (deep charcoal), 'gold' is the accent (soft sage), 'gold_deep' is the secondary accent (pale oak). Renaming them would break nothing but is not worth the churn.

natural._note: Two surfaces, one accent family. Sage and oak shift value between surfaces so contrast holds on both.

type.display_note: Eyebrows and package numerals only. ALL CAPS, wide tracking, never below 20px.
type.headline: Cormorant Garamond
type.headline_note: Questions and statements. Light weight, generous leading, sentence case. Serif throughout, per brief.
type.body_note: Supporting detail only. 300/400 weight, never bold.

feed.name: 4:5 portrait — default for all feed posts

voice.register: Calm, precise, quietly confident. Never hype.
rules: Lead with the answer, never with a hook that withholds it.
Never use fear as a hook. No 'shocking', no 'avoid this at all costs', no 'stop doing this'.
State the limitations of any evidence cited. A null result or a small sample gets said out loud.
If a claim cannot be verified against primary literature, leave it out.
Admitting we got something wrong is a feature. Write it plainly when it happens.
No exclamation marks. No emoji in body copy — a single ✦ divider is the only mark permitted.
Never open with 'Looking for...' or 'Did you know'.
Never use a discount as the primary message.
Never write review text on behalf of a guest.
We are a skincare studio, not a spa. Never use the word spa.

banned_words._note: Temperature descriptors are banned in brand copy — they read against the season half the year. Enforced by engine/copy.py, which fails a caption containing any of these.
exceptions: The body-care device may be described functionally as a 'warm heated bed', and only for expectation management on the Décolleté & Body Care program.
The floor is referred to only as 'Ondol Floor' or 'Traditional Ondol' — never as a heated floor.

ornament.note: Fine botanical line art in the secondary accent, corner-anchored. Never centered, never behind text.

surface_by_kind._note: Which surface each post type renders on when active_palette is 'natural'. Flip a value and re-render to change the grid rhythm; palettes without surfaces ignore this.
